recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of five men in 1980s rock attire posed on a stylized soundstage. The scene features a mix of industrial props like flight cases and trash cans against a backdrop of a twilight sky and green scaffolding. A prominent geometric diamond logo sits at the top, and a vertical red information strip (obi) borders the left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Central band members anchored by industrial props
Geometric logo floating above the horizon line
Vertical red sidebar contrasting with the horizontal blue-to-orange sky
Green scaffolding framing the right side of the composition
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting with warm highlights
A red vertical border on the left containing vertical text
A diamond-shaped logo with internal horizontal bars

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged in a loose horizontal line across the lower two-thirds of the frame, varying in height and posture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure sitting on a black trash can, wearing light-wash denim.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the red vertical strip on the left, across the band members' faces, up to the diamond logo, and down to the wide-spaced text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open twilight sky in the upper center provides breathing room for the logo.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and orange twilight sky providing the background atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red used for the left sidebar and logo accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Acid green on the scaffolding and yellow in the logo lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (red/yellow) against the more naturalistic but moody tones of the photography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with geometric modifications.
letterConstructionRules: Letters in the logo are vertically elongated and fit within a diamond frame
Horizontal bars cut through the center of the logo text
Bottom text is extremely wide-tracked with thin, square proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'R' in the logo have sharp, angular terminals that follow the diamond's slope
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, stacked geometric logo paired with airy, wide-tracked footer text.
graphicDevices: Vertical red obi strip with yellow vertical text
Diamond-shaped emblem with radiating blue lines
Industrial flight cases and trash cans as props

candidateDirections.reason: For the heavy, blocky feel of the logo base.
For the wide-tracked, square-proportioned footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of five men in 80s rock fashion (denim, leather, big hair) posed on a movie studio set. The set includes a black trash can, silver flight cases, and green scaffolding. The background is a twilight sky with orange and blue gradients. Leave a large red vertical strip on the far left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large diamond-shaped logo at the top center with stacked, bold, yellow-to-orange gradient text. Add wide-spaced white block letters across the bottom edge. Add vertical yellow text inside the red strip on the left.

verificationChecks: Is the red vertical strip present on the left?
Is the logo contained within a diamond shape?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-spaced?
Does the lighting feel like a 1980s studio set?

adjustableVariables: Specific props (e.g., replacing trash can with an amp)
Language of the vertical text in the red strip

mustAchieve: Balanced use of the red vertical sidebar

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red strip does not overlap the main subjects' faces.
Check that the diamond logo is centered horizontally.
Verify the bottom text is legible despite the wide tracking.
Confirm the green scaffolding provides a strong vertical element on the right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 1980s studio portrait with a vertical 'obi' strip on the left and a centered geometric diamond logo to create a classic rock album aesthetic.
